svg.title: meeg-utils architecture
svg.desc: Recordings are read with their BIDS sidecars, checked by the acquisition QC, preprocessed run by run (an EEG and an MEG lane), epoched and combined per session; every step records QC metrics, figures and provenance for the reports.
